title: Computational prediction of molecular mechanisms in migration
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iapcadn
materials: Visualize the signaling network with Cytoscape.

steps.title: Obtain mouse PPIN from STRING
steps.instruction: Download the Mus musculus protein‑protein interaction network (PPIN) from the STRING database version 10.0, which contains all known and predicted protein‑protein interactions.

steps.title: Overlay experimental and literature proteins
steps.instruction: Map the proteins identified in the previous mass‑spectrometry analysis of the TMEM30A complex in mouse tissue together with migration‑related genes reported in the literature onto the downloaded STRING PPIN.

steps.title: Extract selected sub‑network
steps.instruction: From the full STRING PPIN, extract the sub‑network consisting only of the proteins that were overlaid in the previous step.

steps.title: Perform enrichment analysis with DAVID
steps.instruction: Upload the list of proteins in the extracted sub‑network to the DAVID tool and run functional and pathway enrichment analyses.
